hero.title: Lightning-fast infrastructure for Norwegian Web Apps
hero.description: Deploy your website in one click — 100% GDPR-compliant on Norwegian infrastructure.

data_sovereignty.title: Data Sovereignty
data_sovereignty.body: All data in Norway. 100% GDPR-compliant. Safe, secure and local.

enterprise.title: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Scalable performance, custom SLAs and dedicated support.

footer.copyright: Snoat — built in Norway. Data stored in Norway. © {{year}}

login.desc_signup: Get started deploying on Norwegian infrastructure.
login.toggle_signup: Don't have an account? Sign Up
login.toggle_signin: Already have an account? Log In
login.data_safety: Your account and all data are stored in Norway.
login.err_invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address
login.error_generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
login.error_network: Could not connect to the server. Please check your internet connection.
login.error_email_unconfirmed: Your email address is not verified. Please check your inbox.
login.error_user_exists: An account with this email address already exists.
login.error_rate_limit: Too many requests. Please try again later.
login.notice_account_exists: This email is already registered. Sign in instead — or use GitHub if that's how you created the account.
login.confirm_sent_desc: We've sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Click the link to activate your account.

dashboard.title: My Projects
dashboard.empty_desc: Connect a GitHub repository and Snoat will automatically build and publish it on your own subdomain.
dashboard.github_connected: GitHub is connected. Your repositories are now listed under «New Project».
dashboard.github_failed: GitHub connection was not completed. Please try again.

new_project_modal.title: New Project
new_project_modal.desc: Snoat automatically detects your framework using Nixpacks — no Dockerfile required.
new_project_modal.public_repo_note: The repository must be public when pasting the URL manually.
new_project_modal.connect_github_prompt: Connect Snoat to GitHub to choose from your repositories. You decide which ones Snoat can access.
new_project_modal.grant_access: Give Snoat access to more repositories

dns.ssl_note: Caddy automatically issues a free Let's Encrypt SSL certificate as soon as your DNS records respond.
dns.connect_desc: Enter the domain you own to generate the DNS records you need to add at your domain provider.
dns.records_desc: Add the following records in your domain provider's control panel (e.g., Cloudflare, Namecheap, GoDaddy).
dns.root_a_desc: Points the apex domain {{domain}} directly to the Snoat server in Norway.
dns.www_cname_desc: Forwards www.{{domain}} to the project's Snoat address.
dns.sub_cname_desc: Forwards {{sub}}.{{domain}} to the project's Snoat address.

project_details.no_deployments: No deployments have been executed yet.
project_details.failed_desc: Check terminal for detailed error log
project_details.env_desc: Environment variables are injected into your container during build and runtime.
project_details.build_cmd_desc: Overrides the automatic build command from Nixpacks (e.g. npm run build:custom).
project_details.danger_desc: Deleting the project will stop running containers and permanently delete all build logs.
project_details.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this project? This action cannot be undone.
project_details.not_found_desc: The project may have been deleted or you do not have access.

project.settings_env_vars_desc: Variables injected into your application at build and runtime.
project.settings_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this project?
project.env_import_desc: Upload a .env file or paste raw text to quickly import variables.
project.env_dropzone: Drag and drop your .env file here, or click to browse

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.desc: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent_desc: If {{email}} is registered with us, we've sent a link to set a new password. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.desc: You're setting a new password for {{email}}.
reset.invalid_desc: The link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one to continue.
reset.error_weak_password: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters with a mix of letters and numbers.
reset.error_same_password: The new password must differ from the old one.
